mapper.sql:
FROM sys_user WHERE is_deleted = 0
AND username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{realName}, '%')
AND status = #{status}
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, real_name, phone, status, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, username, password, real_name, phone, status, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, username, password, real_name, phone, status, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
